summary: The input image or images on images.edit. Despite the endpoint name this is not only for masked editing: passing several images uses them as references and the model composes a new image from their contents.
combines: Multiple images are allowed and are treated as references to draw from, not blended together. OpenAI's own worked example passes four.
A mask applies to the first image only. The rest stay as pure references.
Each file must be under 50MB, and the image and mask must match in format and size.
On gpt-image-2 input_fidelity has no effect here: that model already processes every input at high fidelity and the API rejects attempts to change it.
This is the parameter behind Lixpi's reference-image path, which is why openai-provider.ts branches to images.edit whenever references are present.
